examples.translation: I think that we should try it.

examples.targetHTML: Yo no tengo ninguna duda al respecto.
examples.translation: I have no doubt about it.

examples.targetHTML: Yo quiero acompañarte al centro.
examples.translation: I want to accompany you downtown.

examples.targetHTML: Yo estoy listo cuando tú digas.
examples.translation: I am ready whenever you say.

relations.rule: Subject pronoun: explicitly clarifies or contrasts the 2nd-person actor.
relations.targetHTML: Tú sabes lo que quiero decir.

examples.targetHTML: Tú sabes lo que quiero decir.
examples.translation: You know what I mean.

examples.targetHTML: Tú tienes toda la razón en esto.
examples.translation: You are completely right on this.

examples.targetHTML: Si tú puedes venir, será genial.
examples.translation: If you can come, it will be great.

examples.targetHTML: Tú entiendes mejor que nadie la situación.
examples.translation: You understand the situation better than anyone.

examples.targetHTML: Tú decides qué camino tomar.
examples.translation: You decide which path to take.

relations.rule: Neuter demonstrative: refers to a stated matter, idea, or object near the listener.

examples.targetHTML: Eso es verdad.
examples.translation: That is true.

examples.targetHTML: Eso parece una magnífica solución.
examples.translation: That looks like a magnificent solution.

examples.targetHTML: Eso cambia las cosas por completo.
examples.translation: That changes things completely.

examples.targetHTML: Eso no significa que sea fácil.
examples.translation: That does not mean that it is easy.

examples.targetHTML: Precisamente por eso vine a hablar contigo.
examples.translation: Precisely because of that I came to talk to you.

relations.rule: Neuter demonstrative: refers to an immediate topic or object near the speaker.

examples.targetHTML: Esto es para ti.
examples.translation: This is for you.

examples.targetHTML: Esto funciona a la perfección.
examples.translation: This works to perfection.

examples.targetHTML: Esto parece muy interesante.
examples.translation: This looks very interesting.

examples.targetHTML: Esto me gusta cada día más.
examples.translation: I like this more every day.

examples.targetHTML: Esto apenas comienza.
examples.translation: This is only just beginning.

relations.rule: Universal pronoun: signifies the totality of matters ('everything / all').

examples.targetHTML: Todo está bien.
examples.translation: Everything is fine.

examples.targetHTML: Todo salió según lo planeado.
examples.translation: Everything turned out as planned.

examples.targetHTML: Todo cambió de un momento a otro.
examples.translation: Everything changed from one moment to the next.

examples.targetHTML: Entendí todo sin ninguna dificultad.
examples.translation: I understood everything without any difficulty.

examples.targetHTML: Todo quedó en calma tras la lluvia.
examples.translation: Everything remained calm after the rain.

relations.rule: Indefinite entity: marks an unspecified thing or amount ('something').

examples.targetHTML: Quiero comer algo.
examples.translation: I want to eat something.

examples.targetHTML: Tiene algo importante que contarnos.
examples.translation: Has something important to tell us.

examples.targetHTML: ¿Ha pasado algo mientras estaba fuera?
examples.translation: Did something happen while I was away?

examples.targetHTML: Sé algo sobre este tema histórico.
examples.translation: I know something about this historical topic.

examples.targetHTML: Te traje algo del viaje que te gustará.
examples.translation: I brought you something from the trip you will like.

relations.rule: Causal conjunction: explains the underlying reason or motive.
relations.translation: I did not go because I was tired.

examples.targetHTML: No fui porque estaba cansado.
examples.translation: I did not go because I was tired.

examples.targetHTML: Nos quedamos porque empezó a llover.
examples.translation: We stayed because it started raining.

examples.targetHTML: Estudio español porque me encanta viajar.
examples.translation: I study Spanish because I love traveling.

examples.targetHTML: Sonrió porque recibió buenas noticias.
examples.translation: Smiled because he received good news.

examples.targetHTML: Te pregunto porque me importa tu opinión.
examples.translation: I ask you because your opinion matters to me.

relations.rule: Temporal connector: situates an event at a point in time.

examples.targetHTML: Cuando llegué, todos sonrieron.
examples.translation: When I arrived, everyone smiled.

examples.targetHTML: Cuando puedas, pásate por mi oficina.
examples.translation: When you can, drop by my office.

examples.targetHTML: Cuando sale el sol, la plaza se llena de gente.
examples.translation: When the sun rises, the square fills with people.

examples.targetHTML: Cuando era niño, vivía cerca del mar.
examples.translation: When I was a boy, I lived near the sea.

examples.targetHTML: Cuando despertó, el tren ya había llegado.
examples.translation: When he woke up, the train had already arrived.
